changes.comment: Keep a Git clone of the content repository on the data volume instead of a SQLite draft store and the GitHub and GitLab APIs. Configure it with `MICA_REPOSITORY_URL` and `MICA_REPOSITORY_TOKEN` instead of `REPOSITORY`, `REPOSITORY_*`, `DATA_DIR` and `DATABASE_PATH`, check a setup with the `check` command, and resolve conflicts with changes made on the website. Any Git host over HTTPS should work; GitLab needs only `read_repository` and `write_repository`.
